title.narrative: Amu Bukhara Irrigation System Rehabilitation Project

description.narrative: The proposed project is located in Bukhara Province and two districts in Navoi Province in the central part of Uzbekistan. The project will ensuer a sustainable and reliable water supply for irrigated agriculture in the main command area of 250,000 ha in the Amu Bukhara Irrigation System (ABIS) and drinking water for 725,000 population.

Progress Toward Outcome: The works for construction of new Amu Bukhara 1 pump station (ICB/01) are ongoing. Modernization and rehabilitation of Kuyu Mazar and Kizil Tepa and Kizil Tepa 1 pump stations is completed. Modernization and rehabilitation of Amu Bukhara II pump station is ongoing. Modernization and rehabilitation of ABMC regulating structures is ongoing.

The plan has been prepared in Q2 2017.
According to this plan, measures are being taken to reduce electricity consumption by replacing old pumping units in 5 pumping stations with new energy-saving ones. Due to the modernization of 42 pieces of pumping units in 3 pumping stations, the consumption of electricity was reduced from 1650 million kWh (indicator in 2017) to 1450 million kWh (today), that is, the savings in electricity amounted to 200 million kWh or 10-12%. Regarding water-saving operation, ABMK is taking appropriate measures in accordance with the established limit.
SCADA works have been started and expected to complete by end of Q3 2024
